exact.description: C2 exactly as measured at gate v235/v238: 4 users x 131072-token context, 256-token output budget

c2.description: C2-any (plan stage S1, internal): the exact geometry (131328 positions, 2052-page tables, 8208 KV blocks = 4 x 2052) serving ANY request the edge admits. QWEN_FAST_ANY_REQUEST=1 builds one engine per request, with no packed block beside it, without replay attention and the per-request T16 gate (their captures are 1, 2 and 4 rows, which never replay), runs the gate's source qualification once at attach, gives each request its own max_tokens as its budget, and ends a host-side refusal of one request's own terms (its sampling contract, budget or page table) as that request's FINISHED_ABORTED instead of the engine's death; every other refusal still fails the engine. Output ceiling 16384; prompts up to 123136, so every admitted prompt keeps at least 8192 tokens of answer room; max_tokens 8192 when the client omits it. An omitted max_tokens is recognised as vLLM fills it (0.25.1 get_max_tokens: the whole remaining context, max_model_len - prompt), so an EXPLICIT max_tokens of exactly max_model_len - prompt reads as omitted and also gets 8192; ask for any other value to get the clamp instead. Decode is 4-row sequential, and no packed block is built (QWEN_FAST_PACKED_STEP=0): it needs every live user inside [131072, 131328), which the 123136-token prompt cap never reaches, and it held 3.84 GB per chip that four per-request engines need (run 36218104858 ran out of DRAM building the fourth). The padded block goes with it (QWEN_FAST_PADDED_BLOCK=0); the single gate/up copy stays, admitted because no verify reaches 16 rows (serving_runtime.c2_any_without_block). UNVERIFIED on hardware: per-request decode more than 256 positions past its capture (every budget served so far was <= 256), and the proposal ladder a short prompt builds at a long budget (up to four buckets per user, R3). Not qualified for production traffic.

c2-gate.description: GATE ONLY (the c2 bring-up at v235's shape): c2's environment - QWEN_FAST_ANY_REQUEST=1, output ceiling 16384 - with exact's prompt limit, 131072 (min_answer_tokens 256, no max_prompt_tokens), so the 4 x 131072 real-text bring-up runs c2's code where v235 ran and compares byte for byte: at 131072 every request's budget is min(max_tokens, 256), and the four-user packed block engages beside the Phase 0 engines. The engine argv is exact's. Not for traffic: a 131072-token prompt leaves 256 tokens of answer.

c2-packed.description: C2-packed-any (plan stage S2): c2 WITH the 64-row packed block, serving it at any position. c2's environment less its two block overrides (QWEN_FAST_PACKED_STEP=0, QWEN_FAST_PADDED_BLOCK=0), so the image's QWEN_FAST_PACKED_STEP=1 and QWEN_FAST_PADDED_BLOCK=1 build the block, plus QWEN_FAST_EXTENT_REPLAY=1: each packed user reads its own 256-key family E = (start // 256 + 1) * 256 through one K64j 0x27 program per bundle (graft K64j, flag 0x20, a per-bundle cur_pos tensor), so 2-4 live users at any positions >= 128 share one verify round instead of 4-row sequential rounds. c2's limits: prompts up to 123136 (at least 8192 tokens of answer room), output ceiling 16384, max_tokens 8192 when omitted, parser M. The attach is refused unless packed_any_admission admits it (the M3 shape, eight-row groups, the tree-scratch patch, K64j at both binary paths with its kernels, and packed_any_evidence.json recording CB1, CB2a and CB2b PASS); a refused attach fails closed and c2 keeps serving. NOT QUALIFIED for traffic until the S2 gates (design 6.3, M0-M12) pass.

c2-packed-gate.description: GATE ONLY (S2's flag-on arms, G3/G3b/M1): c2-gate plus QWEN_FAST_EXTENT_REPLAY=1 - c2-gate's environment, engine and limits (no prompt cap, min_answer_tokens 256, so 4 x 131072 runs where v235 ran), with the packed block serving through the K64j extent readers. Its flag-off twin is c2-gate. Not for traffic: a 131072-token prompt leaves 256 tokens of answer.

c2-packed-tp4.description: C2-packed-any at TP4 (plan S2-TP4), traffic profile: the c2-packed stack on all four cards as one (1, 4) mesh (mesh_device P150x4, QWEN_FAST_TP=4): the four-card ring descriptor at two links (tp4_mesh: 2x2), FABRIC_1D with the model's own Ring collectives, the fast path's own collectives at Linear until the fabric probe says otherwise (QWEN_FAST_CCL_TOPOLOGY, mesh_link_policy), QWEN_PROJECTION_LINKS=2 (two trained links per edge), the K64j extent program at ONE KV head per chip (QWEN_FAST_SDPA_MODES=tail,share: 0x23; the q-slice needs a second KV head) at G8B2, the packed GDN launch at 12 value heads on 48 cores, and no on-device sampler: the fast path verifies with its own shard argmax over 62,080 columns per chip (248,320 / 4). The image's other flags are the pair's (QWEN_FAST_TP is what makes the fast path read four-card widths, and serving_startup refuses a width the opened mesh does not have), except nine switched OFF because their code carries the pair's chip or head literals in text-patched, kernel or two-chip form that this port has not reached: the quad draft, the fused commit and its in-place / live-bank variants, the draft K/V slide, the traced publish's K/V fusion, the MLP block stream, the GDN direct-window and shared-QK experiments. The attach's own pair-only scopes are the four-card twins (attach_scopes_tp, rebound by tp_addresses at startup): the sampler's gather links at the ring's audited two, and the direct-window and K/V-publication scopes stand down (they patch nothing and refuse a profile that switches them on). The bring-up switches are general-tp4's: the fused prefill matmul + reduce-scatter off, the exact prefill conv audited beside the FIR for the first four chunks. NOT QUALIFIED: packed_any_evidence_tp4.json records no section, so the attach is refused by packed_any_admission except in a gate run (QWEN_C2_GATE=1), which logs each missing piece as UNQUALIFIED; the K64j extent program at one KV head, the GDN kernels at 12 heads, the drafter at 8 / 2 heads and the four-card collectives have not run on hardware. Engine and limits are c2-packed's (prompts up to 123,136 with at least 8,192 tokens of answer room, output ceiling 16,384, parser M), no audits. Until the four-card record qualifies the attach is refused and nothing serves; it is not placed until G7 at TP4 passes.

c2-packed-prefix.description: c2-packed with conversation prefix reuse (sticky sessions): c2-packed's environment, limits and packed extent block, plus the prefix-reuse grafts. Sticky sessions, phase 1 (QWEN_FAST_STICKY_SESSIONS=1 beside QWEN_PREFIX_REUSE=1): a turn that extends an earlier one of the same salted conversation resumes exactly from the last 2048-token boundary at or below its prompt minus 2048 whose GDN checkpoint and KV prefix the prefix-reuse grafts kept - vLLM's prefix cache (sha256 block hashes, published below floor2048(P)) and the host checkpoint store (QWEN_PREFIX_STORE_GIB) - and prefills only the tail; the engine is built as on the no-reuse twin, and anything else takes the twin's cold path. A hit is byte-identical to a cold prefill of the same prompt (the G1 exactness argument: the same chunk program from a canonical checkpoint). The argv is the twin's with enable-prefix-caching and enable-chunked-prefill in place of the no- flags (vLLM asserts chunking for a hybrid model with prefix caching; the TT platform turns it off again) and prefix-caching-hash-algo sha256. Hits need a platform-minted cache_salt (serving_c2_contract.salt_verdict); unsalted requests neither hit nor publish. Kill switch: /models/.qwen-c2/prefix-reuse.off. NOT QUALIFIED for traffic until the sticky-session hardware gates pass.

coding.description: NOT SERVABLE: the fast path refuses any request whose prompt is not exactly the frozen context or whose remaining budget exceeds 256 (frozen_combined_runtime.validate_target_option; smoke v3, run 36099730091). Kept for the record.

general.description: The C2 image with the fast path OFF: the stock TT plugin decode with the image's kernels (K64j) and model graft, no speculative decoding, any request shape (sampling, long outputs, any prompt length). The fast path serves only prompts of exactly its frozen context (frozen_combined_runtime.validate_target_option).

general-2link.description: general on the pair at the two links this cabling trains: the TP2 reference and baseline for the TP4 jobs (J2r agreement, J3r benchmark). general itself pins upstream's p150_x2 descriptor, which declares four channels per edge; the TT plugin's default fabric reliability, STRICT_INIT, refuses an open whose edge trained fewer links than declared (control_plane.cpp), and M-A trains two, so general cannot open on this cabling. This profile is general with mesh_device P300 (the image's own pair MESH_DEVICE, tt_ccl's table gives it 2 links) under a two-channel 1x2 descriptor (tp4_mesh.pair_descriptor_text). Same engine, context, seats and environment as general; a bring-up profile for the reference, not the fast path (the contract refuses qwen_fast_t16 under it). UNVERIFIED on hardware until J2r opens it.

general-prefix.description: general with conversation prefix reuse (the TT prefix-reuse design, G1): vLLM's attention prefix cache plus GDN checkpoints the model saves at 2048-token boundaries, so a turn that extends an earlier prompt re-prefills only from the last checkpoint below its vLLM hit, byte-identical to a cold prefill. Exactly general's engine argv with enable-prefix-caching and enable-chunked-prefill in place of the no- flags (the argv the P0a probe built and passed): vLLM's align-mode assertion needs chunking on, and the TT platform turns chunking off again for qwen3_5 and raises max-num-batched-tokens to max-model-len, so prefill stays whole-prompt. QWEN_PREFIX_REUSE=1 switches every prefix-reuse graft in the image on (the model's supports_prefix_caching, the scheduler graft, the runner patch); QWEN_PREFIX_STORE_GIB is the host checkpoint budget (about 154 MB per checkpoint; design D-P4). Hits need a cache_salt the platform minted: the API server drops any cache_salt that does not verify against the salt key in /models/.qwen-c2/prefix-salt.key (serving_c2_contract.salt_verdict), so without that key no request hits and the profile serves as general does (fail closed; the ADM gateway must mint salts first, design 2.2 need 4). prefix-caching-hash-algo is pinned to sha256, vLLM's default. The runtime kill switch is the file /models/.qwen-c2/prefix-reuse.off. Needs an image whose prefix stage grafted every target (/opt/qwen-c2/prefix-stage.json complete=true); without it the platform drops prefix caching and vLLM refuses to start. Not the default: UNVERIFIED on hardware until the G1 gates pass.

general-prefix-eager.description: GATE ONLY (G1's eager exactness gate, design F1): general-prefix with trace_mode decode_only, so prefill takes the eager chunk loop - the loop C1 reuses on the fast path - instead of the traced one. Everything else is general-prefix's. Not for traffic: the eager prefill is slower, and gate_only makes the contract refuse to boot it without QWEN_C2_GATE=1.

general-tp4.description: general at TP4, 8 seats x 65,536: All four p150a cards as one (1, 4) mesh (mesh_device P150x4, TP4): the four-card ring descriptor (tp4_mesh: 2x2, 2 channels), FABRIC_1D (the plugin default, stated) with the model's own Ring collectives at 2 links (tt_ccl P150x4), the ring check at mesh open, and on-device sampling for decode (sample_on_device_mode decode_only: 248,320 / 4 = 62,080 logits per device fits the sampler; the TT plugin falls back to host sampling per batch for min_p, logit_bias, bad_words, any logprobs request (at four devices the fixture refuses device sampling for a batch with a logprobs request) and the like, and /models/.qwen-c2/device-sampling.off or QWEN_HOST_SAMPLING=1 drops it for every batch). The image's model graft and kernels are TP-generic (per-device widths from tp = 4); the GDN kernels were qualified at 24 value heads per chip and run 12 here. KV per chip at TP4 is one KV head: 16 attention layers x (K, V) x 1 head x 256 x 1.0625 B (bf8, QWEN_SDPA_BF8=1) = 8,704 B per token, half the pair's 17,408 (4 x 131,328 held 9.149 GB per chip at TP2, four-streams feasibility doc). Per chip: weights ~7.4 GB (27.49 GiB / 4), non-weight non-KV <= 6.9 GB (the TP2 plain path's bound 21.69 - 14.8, assumed not to shrink), so ~14.3 GB before KV of the ~33.9 GB each chip allocates. Pool 8 x 65,536 = 524,288 tokens = 4.56 GB per chip - the same KV per chip as general's 4 x 65,536 on the pair - leaving ~15 GB per chip free (d, until G5 at TP4 measures it). Twice general's seats; B = 8 fits the GDN core waves at TP4 (8 x 12 = 96 value heads of 110 cores). UNVERIFIED on hardware until the TP4 jobs pass (J2 smoke and agreement, J3 benchmark). TP4 bring-up switches (env): QWEN_GDN_PREFILL_MMRS=0 keeps the fused matmul + reduce-scatter prefill out-projection off (it deadlocked on the pair and has never run at four devices; the general-tp4-mmrs profile is its dedicated arm), and QWEN_FAST_GDN_PREFILL_CONV_AUDIT=4 runs the exact prefill conv beside the FIR for the first four chunks at C = 2560, kd = 512 (a shape that has never run on hardware) and stops the engine on a byte mismatch; drop it once J2 passes.

general-tp4-mmrs.description: GATE ONLY (J2m, the fused-prefill arm): general-tp4 with QWEN_GDN_PREFILL_MMRS=1, the fused matmul + reduce-scatter prefill out-projection on at four devices. It deadlocked on the pair; upstream validated it on its own P150x4 box. Run it after J2 passed with the fused op off, so a hang here costs one job and is attributed to the op. Not for traffic. UNVERIFIED on hardware.

general-prefix-tp4.description: general-prefix at TP4, 8 seats x 65,536: general-tp4's engine with conversation prefix reuse, exactly as general-prefix is general's (enable-prefix-caching and enable-chunked-prefill in place of the no- flags, QWEN_PREFIX_REUSE=1, sha256 block hashes, hits only under a platform-minted cache_salt, kill switch /models/.qwen-c2/prefix-reuse.off). All four p150a cards as one (1, 4) mesh (mesh_device P150x4, TP4): the four-card ring descriptor (tp4_mesh: 2x2, 2 channels), FABRIC_1D (the plugin default, stated) with the model's own Ring collectives at 2 links (tt_ccl P150x4), the ring check at mesh open, and on-device sampling for decode (sample_on_device_mode decode_only: 248,320 / 4 = 62,080 logits per device fits the sampler; the TT plugin falls back to host sampling per batch for min_p, logit_bias, bad_words, any logprobs request (at four devices the fixture refuses device sampling for a batch with a logprobs request) and the like, and /models/.qwen-c2/device-sampling.off or QWEN_HOST_SAMPLING=1 drops it for every batch). The image's model graft and kernels are TP-generic (per-device widths from tp = 4); the GDN kernels were qualified at 24 value heads per chip and run 12 here. Pool 524,288 tokens, 4.56 GB per chip (general-tp4 says how). The host checkpoint store stays 8 GiB (a checkpoint is the whole model's GDN state, ~154 MB, at any TP). Its no-reuse baseline for the prefix gates is general-tp4. UNVERIFIED on hardware until the G1 gates pass at TP4. TP4 bring-up switches (env): QWEN_GDN_PREFILL_MMRS=0 keeps the fused matmul + reduce-scatter prefill out-projection off (it deadlocked on the pair and has never run at four devices; the general-tp4-mmrs profile is its dedicated arm), and QWEN_FAST_GDN_PREFILL_CONV_AUDIT=4 runs the exact prefill conv beside the FIR for the first four chunks at C = 2560, kd = 512 (a shape that has never run on hardware) and stops the engine on a byte mismatch; drop it once J2 passes.
